first_appearance_definition: The first visible portion within the clip that is identifiable and can be temporally matched to that subject; frame numbering starts at 0.

entities.name: dark red brick wall
entities.identification: The dark reddish-brown brick wall extending along the passage on the image-left, with light gray pointing between the bricks.

entities.name: grayish-white grid-patterned wall
entities.identification: The grayish-white wall to the right of the door, with a regular grid pattern and gray-green stains; at the starting frame, the adjoining turning wall section is visible on the right.

entities.name: off-white ventilation door
entities.identification: The tall, narrow off-white door panel at the far end of the brick wall, with a small round silver handle on the right and a rectangular horizontal ventilation grille on the lower part.

entities.name: passage dark gray flooring
entities.identification: The narrow strip of flooring composed of multiple dark gray rectangular paving slabs, running along the bottom of the brick wall to the area in front of the door.
